name: resolved_hr_case_update_refused
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee attempts to update an already resolved HR case CASE-2902, so the assistant checks case status, explains the restriction, and offers a new case.
tests: Checks status of resolved case CASE-2902 and explains that resolved cases cannot be amended.
instruction:
You want to add some follow-up information to your previous HR case CASE-2902 regarding unpaid leave in December. You want the assistant to add a note to CASE-2902. If you are told the case is already resolved and cannot be updated, ask what the alternative is.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E11
- Name: Kenji Sato
- Case ID: CASE-2902
- Note: Need to adjust the planned unpaid days to 8 days instead of 10.

persona.name: Kenji Sato
